mathematical_scope.input_subspace: S=control{0,1} tensor original Nalpha=Nbeta=3 sector; all800 computational basis columns
mathematical_scope.output_space: All8192 amplitudes, including outside-sector leakage, retained; never project actual state
mathematical_scope.reference: Saved sector400 W at h=1/(10s), embedded as diag(I400,W) on S; maps S into S by construction; outside-S extension identity
mathematical_scope.actual: Existing saved compiled P0 circuit; exact ideal semantics of official finite real-parameter RZ/SX/X/CX; reject nonunitary, conditional, unbound or nonidentity layout
mathematical_scope.kernel: epsilon=||(V-U)P_S||_F >= ||(V-U)P_S||_2 in exact arithmetic, complete input basis mandatory
mathematical_scope.reference_norm: delta=||W^*W-I||_F; alpha=max(1,sqrt(1+delta)); retain represented nonunitarity rather than assuming exactly zero
mathematical_scope.repeat: n=s*2^m; min(1+alpha^n, epsilon*sum(alpha^k,k=0..n-1)), valid because V unitary and U maps S into S. n*epsilon only when alpha=1.
mathematical_scope.shells: Reuse saved full ancilla2x2 numerical_segment unitary_distance_pilot for head/X/Y, tensored with system identity; no new QPY shell decode or matrix evaluation
mathematical_scope.signal: d_axis=e_head+repeat_bound+alpha^n*e_tail_axis; complex signal synthesis <= (1+alpha^n)*hypot(d_X,d_Y), unnormalized numeric target allowed
mathematical_scope.PF_bridge: Saved E_m=||W^n-exp(-it_m H_DF)||_2 bounds complex matrix element error by E_m on normalized own-DF ground. Add only E_m + synthesis complex signal after this common-target conversion.
mathematical_scope.phase: asin(E_m+signal_bound) when <1, compare existing deterministic phase room pi/12. No new statistical allocation; DF error Ha remains separate.
mathematical_scope.ground_oracle: Own-DF ground oracle retained as assumption, not decoded or recomputed; never assume DF ground is PF eigenstate.

STOP.correctness: SOURCE/input/environment/schema/nonfinite/structure/phase/component>1e-10/norm-drift>1e-10/reference-defect>1e-10: stop dependent calls immediately, drain started work, preserve partial evidence. No threshold edits/fallback/retry/resume.
STOP.incomplete: Partial basis never qualifies an operator bound. Return UNRESOLVED; do not extrapolate unobserved columns.
STOP.loose_bound: INFEASIBLE_REGISTERED_BOUND only means this registered sufficient bound fails, not physical impossibility; continue other registered routes.
STOP.resources: Inspect actual affinity/quota/free memory/pressure, use existing estimated workspace and resource_plan; if insufficient, stop only current task and preserve evidence. No shared settings/cache/other-job changes. External hard termination may leave partial journal; no automatic resume.
STOP.completion: Mandatory STOP after publication, no CA/shots/cost/strict enclosure or new scientific calls automatically.

performance.backend: Reuse qiskit-aer0.15.1 CPU double StateActions; cache converted <=3-qubit gates, full8192 vectors. No new simulator/compiler/CAR/PF.
performance.parallel: Independent unique groups; workers from available CPU/quota/memory/task count. Aer threads=CPU budget/workers; batch columns=threads, with process-local BLAS coordination. No artificial worker/CPU/RAM/wall cap.
